title: A Go toolchain action moves go.mod and leaves every other file its change names
foundBy: deps-maintenance campaign, pilots 1 and 2: the pilot2 orchestrator's findings (campaign-workspaces/deps-maintenance/pilot2/archives/deps-pilot2-20260922T203209Z/orchestrator/output/findings.md) and the step corrections pilot3's coordination.md section 5 carries
details:
A `routine:runtime` action for the Go toolchain emits one step, `go mod edit -go=<version>`, while the change's own `files` name `go.golangci.mod` as well. Run as printed, it raises `go.mod` and leaves `go.golangci.mod` on the old floor, so the linter builds against it. The steps are built from the record's first source only.

In sandbox the same record also points at `ARG GO_VERSION` in `image/Containerfile.base`, and the action emits `go mod edit -go=1.27.1` with `cwd: image`, where no `go.mod` exists. It fails there, and the ARG and the checksums beside it never move.

Seen in the report of 2026-09-22T05:24:19Z: `campaign`, `ledger`, `lint`, `npmrevs`, `tracer`, `vcr` and `sandbox:routine:runtime`.
